lineage.description: Building footprints were collected through OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset contains approximately 817.2 thousand mapped buildings with metadata on data age and recent updates, representing an estimated 12% of total buildings in Angola based on AI-assisted mapping validation.
